title: What is artificial intelligence?
examples: Can AI learn things on its own like humans do?
What is the difference between a simple program and AI?
What are some things AI cannot do yet?

explain.say: Today we say what artificial intelligence means for computers.

items: AI aims to mimic human intelligence.
It uses data to make decisions.

explain.say: A normal program just follows exact step by step instructions.
AI, however, can learn patterns from lots of examples given to it.
A good example is a spam filter in your email account.
Another example is a video game opponent that adapts to you playing.
AI struggles with common sense or understanding sarcasm in conversation.

items: AI needs massive amounts of data.

faq.q: Is a calculator really using artificial intelligence?
faq.a: No, a calculator follows fixed mathematical rules exactly. It cannot learn new functions on its own.
asks: Is basic math a form of AI?

faq.q: How is machine learning different from just programming?
faq.a: Programming requires you to write every single rule. Machine learning lets the computer find rules by looking at examples.
asks: What is the difference between coding and learning?
Does machine learning mean it thinks?

faq.q: What are some things AI is good at doing?
faq.a: AI is very good at recognizing patterns in huge amounts of data, like faces or voices. It excels at classification tasks.
asks: What tasks are best for AI?

faq.q: Can AI understand human emotions like happiness or sadness?
faq.a: Currently, AI can only detect patterns that relate to emotion, like tone of voice. It does not feel those emotions itself.

faq.q: Does AI need electricity to work?
faq.a: Yes, all current AI systems run on physical hardware that requires electricity to process information. This is true for all computers.

facts: AI systems are often trained using vast datasets of information.
A traditional program executes instructions sequentially without deviation.
Machine learning allows systems to improve performance with more data.
AI currently struggles with tasks requiring common sense reasoning.

quiz.say: A program that calculates the area of a circle using the formula pi times radius squared is an example of:
quiz.why: The calculator only follows the fixed, known mathematical steps you programmed it to use.

wrong.0: This is wrong because machine learning implies improving based on varied data, not just one formula.
wrong.2: This is wrong because AI learns patterns, it does not just calculate a known formula.
wrong.3: This is wrong because while it uses an algorithm, the concept of 'normal program' is more accurate for fixed steps.

quiz.say: If an AI system is trained on thousands of pictures of dogs and cats, what skill is it developing?
quiz.why: Training on many examples allows the AI to recognize the underlying patterns that define a dog or a cat.

wrong.0: This is wrong because deduction requires understanding rules, which is different from recognizing visual patterns.
wrong.1: This is wrong because execution is following steps; pattern recognition is finding the rules from the data.
wrong.2: This is wrong because common sense involves general knowledge, not just visual data sets.

quiz.say: Which statement best describes a limit of current AI technology?

options.show: It struggles with common sense or sarcasm.
options.say: It struggles with common sense or sarcasm.

quiz.why: AI is excellent at data tasks but lacks the general, intuitive understanding of the real world that humans possess.

wrong.0: This is wrong because modern AI can process images, speech, and text.
wrong.1: This is wrong because the ability to learn from data is the core strength of AI.
wrong.3: This is wrong because all current AI systems require electricity to function.
